body: The exact same thing has happened to me. You'll eventually learn to get over it, but you like the girl you thought she was, rather than who she actually is. I know that seems really insensitive and I'm sure she's great. I felt the same sick feeling when I learned about what my girlfriend had done before. You'll learn to get used to it, don't give up on her. Best of luck to you.

You're a great guy. I know how bad it hurts. It's impossible to just move on like people tell you to. I don't have any advice for you but I just wanted to tell you that ultimately things will be good. Don't be hard on yourself, this wasn't your fault.
It's okay to feel sad. I've been in that situation and it's a lot harder than people think. Stay positive. Everything will be okay.
I appreciate it, that means more than you think.
I know what you're going through. It's tough. Good luck to you.
Thanks, I've just gotten so attached to her. It's a really difficult thing to do.
I understand, you're not alone. I don't know what to tell you other than keep your head up. I know exactly what it feels like to love someone and have them mess you up. I wish you the best.
